body:
Core changes are fine - I actually used the same optimization for https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99971.
Can't say anything about the rest of the code.

Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/ad90101d97a768570bcec80939b92b94651c5293), it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-6000 CL30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 44)
</details>

Using an optimized editor build.

Time taken to open the editor, import the MRP of https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/123948 and exit the editor after removing `.godot/imported` (average of 10 runs):

```
Benchmark 1: bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.master --path /home/hugo/Downloads/mrp-filesystem-thumbnails/ --import (10 runs)
                mean     ±       σ          min     …     max
  Wall Time   15.779 s   ±   0.463 s     15.369 s   …  16.765 s
  Memory         1.8 GiB ±     0.0 GiB      1.8 GiB …     1.8 GiB
 
Benchmark 2: bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --path /home/hugo/Downloads/mrp-filesystem-thumbnails/ --import (10 runs)
                mean     ±       σ          min     …     max
  Wall Time   14.644 s   ±   0.084 s     14.544 s   …  14.803 s             -7.2%  
  Memory         1.8 GiB ±     0.0 GiB      1.8 GiB …     1.8 GiB           -1.0%  
```

Time taken to open the editor, import [tps-demo](https://github.com/godotengine/tps-demo) and exit the editor after removing `.godot/imported` (average of 10 runs):

```
Benchmark 1: bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.master --path /home/hugo/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --import (10 runs)
                mean     ±       σ          min     …     max
  Wall Time   15.619 s   ±   0.089 s     15.489 s   …  15.710 s
  Memory         4.2 GiB ±     0.1 GiB      4.1 GiB …     4.3 GiB
 
Benchmark 2: bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --path /home/hugo/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --import (10 runs)
                mean     ±       σ          min     …     max
  Wall Time   15.522 s   ±   0.062 s     15.431 s   …  15.647 s             -0.6%  
  Memory         4.1 GiB ±     0.0 GiB      4.1 GiB …     4.2 GiB           -1.3%  
```

Command used:

```
hyperfine -iw1 -p "rm -rf /path/to/project/.godot/imported" "bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64.master --path /path/to/project --import" "bin/godot.linuxbsd.editor.x86_64 --path /path/to/project --import"
```

The wall clock time improvement isn't huge, but it's definitely noticeable in the MRP at least.
